frames.title: Record inventory
frames.description: Front-right, standing behind a small administrative table recording supply counts in an OPEN inventory ledger with quill, inkpot and stacked paper present.

frames.title: Explain allocations
frames.description: Front-left, standing beside same table explaining allocation with an open-hand gesture while other hand indicates a supply list.

frames.title: Examine tool
frames.description: Right-side, examining a metal tool head closely in one hand, with tools neatly laid on compact wooden bench.

frames.title: Count supplies
frames.description: Front-right, counting sacks and small boxes on a wooden supply table, tally stick in hand and open ledger nearby.

frames.title: Repair satchel
frames.description: Front-left, repairing the buckle on a leather satchel at a small wooden bench with awl and needle, both hands engaged.

frames.title: Check weights
frames.description: Front-right, checking weights on a small balance scale on administrative table beside a pouch of coins and OPEN ledger.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
